integrity.canonical_basis: The canonical divisor of a threefold point blow-up is the pullback plus twice the exceptional divisor.
integrity.geometric_basis: Aholt--Sturmfels--Thomas identify the generic multiprojective multiview variety with the blow-up of P3 at the camera focal points.
integrity.motivic_basis: The codimension-three point blow-up formula adds one Lefschetz motive in degrees one and two for each focal point.
integrity.msc_basis: The arXiv record lists MSC 14N first, followed by 14Q and 68.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the generic multiprojective point multiview variety, not degenerate camera arrangements or single-projective compactifications.
The motivic and anticanonical formulas use the blow-up structure and do not determine multiview ideals, multidegrees, or Euclidean-distance degree.
An equivalent unindexed observation remains a residual originality risk because the derivation from the blow-up description is short.
title: A motivic and anticanonical identity for generic multiview threefolds
